description:
Search the live Chrome Web Store extensions fetched so far, for market and niche research.
listed and known in each answer show how much of the store that covers.

Filter by title keywords (match "all" or "any") and by inclusive ranges on users,
rating, reviews, language count and description length; sort by any of those or by
last update. Answers come from a catalog refreshed weekly, so this never fetches and
never answers "pending". users, rating and reviews are null when the store shows no
number, which is not zero. For one extension's full page, call get_store_listing.

Allows 60 calls a minute per account.

Needs an ExtensionDash account. Without one, find_listing and get_store_listing still read any extension's current store page; sign up at https://extensiondash.com/signup and reconnect using the URL on your /profile page for anything else.

dir.description: Defaults to desc. Nulls always last.
